## Checklist

- [ ] I searched `megakernel_landscape/data/catalog.json` by title, project
      name, arXiv/DOI ID, repository slug, and aliases, and found no duplicate.
- [ ] Every added entry has a primary or authoritative evidence link.
- [ ] Titles, dates, venue, authors, code ownership, and tags were verified
      against primary sources; no author role or paper/code relationship was
      inferred.
- [ ] Each numerical performance claim includes its hardware, workload,
      software/version, baseline/configuration, metric, date, and a direct
      evidence link.
- [ ] I edited the catalog rather than generated `CATALOG:*` blocks, supplied
      both English and Chinese descriptive fields, and linked related IDs.
- [ ] I bumped the catalog version/date and added the matching newest changelog
      entry.
- [ ] Entries are in the correct section, follow the existing format, and are
      ordered newest first.
- [ ] All new or changed links resolve to the intended artifact and contain no
      unnecessary tracking parameters.
- [ ] I ran `make -C megakernel_landscape all`, reviewed both generated
      READMEs, and then ran `make -C megakernel_landscape check`.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check` and reviewed the diff for unrelated formatting
      changes or accidental removals.
- [ ] I understand that contributions to this curated repository are made
      available under CC0 1.0 Universal; linked works retain their own licenses.
